items.description: Esquipulas in Matagalpa is a coffee-growing community, named after the Black Christ of Esquipulas statue.
La Dalia in Matagalpa is a major coffee-producing region, known for its mountainous terrain and agricultural output.
Matiguás in Matagalpa is an important agricultural center, known for cattle ranching and dairy products.
San Ramón in Matagalpa is a mountainous municipality, known for its quality coffee and green landscapes.
Terrabona in Matagalpa is known for its agricultural production, particularly coffee and beans.
San Fernando in Nueva Segovia is a small rural community on the border with Honduras.
El Jícaro in Nueva Segovia is a mining town, famous for its gold exploitation and mining history.
Desembocadura de Río Grande is a coastal community at the mouth of the Río Grande, known for its fishing.
Corn Island (Islas del Maíz) are two Caribbean islands, known for their coral reefs and relaxed atmosphere.
La Cruz de Río Grande is a rural community in the North Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region, known for its indigenous cultures.
Morrito on the Río San Juan is a small fishing village, known for its tranquility and proximity to Lake Nicaragua.
San Jorge in Rivas is a port town on Lake Nicaragua, an important ferry terminal to Ometepe Island.
Belén in Rivas is an agricultural community that cultivates rice and sugar cane.
Potosí in Rivas is a small community, known for its thermal springs and proximity to volcanoes.
Buenos Aires in Rivas is a quiet agricultural community, known for its rice and sugar cane cultivation.
